An Iron Heart Part I#001.src: Oh, you there! I wasn't expecting a human soldier to be here, but you've come at a perfect time. I could use some help, see.
An Iron Heart Part I#001.dst: 喔，那邊那位！我沒想到這裡會有人類士兵，不過你來得正是時候。我這兒正需要幫手。
An Iron Heart Part I#001.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#002.src: I'm certain you know about Guard Golems, yes? They're manufactured here in Gavel, and I bought one recently.
An Iron Heart Part I#002.dst: 你應該知道守衛魔像吧？那是在 Gavel 這裡製造的，我最近買了一台。
An Iron Heart Part I#002.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#003.src: The goblins keep trying to forage in my farms, you see- I needed something to keep them out, and a Golem would have been perfect.
An Iron Heart Part I#003.dst: 那些哥布林老是想跑到我的農田裡翻找東西——我需要點什麼把牠們擋在外面，而魔像本來是最合適的。
An Iron Heart Part I#003.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#004.src: But, shortly after I activated it, the thing attacked me! I nearly got killed- It was ramming itself against boulders and walls...
An Iron Heart Part I#004.dst: 可是我才剛啟動它沒多久，那東西就攻擊我！我差點沒命——它一直拿自己去撞岩石和牆壁……
An Iron Heart Part I#004.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#005.src: I obviously was sold a defective model... That golem is a danger to everything around it. Do you think you're up to subduing it?
An Iron Heart Part I#005.dst: 我八成是買到瑕疵品了……那台魔像對周遭的一切都是威脅。你覺得你制伏得了它嗎？
An Iron Heart Part I#005.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#006.src: It's shed a trail of scrap, as you can see. Please, follow the trail of scrap and keep it from causing anyone more damage!
An Iron Heart Part I#006.dst: 你看得出來，它一路上掉了不少碎片。拜託，順著那些碎片追過去，別讓它再傷到別人了！
An Iron Heart Part I#006.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#007.src: Find the defective Guard Golem in the mountain at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
An Iron Heart Part I#007.dst: 在 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的山中找到那台瑕疵的守衛魔像

An Iron Heart Part I#008.dst: 找到那台瑕疵的守衛魔像

An Iron Heart Part I#009.src: ...I am... w̶h̴at^s my...na̷m̸e...? I had one...

An Iron Heart Part I#010.src: Re...remember!! W̵H̸A̶T̸ IS MY N̵A̴M̵E̵? My life?
An Iron Heart Part I#010.dst: 想……想起來！！W̵H̸A̶T̸ IS MY N̵A̴M̵E̵？我的人生呢？

An Iron Heart Part I#011.src: REMEMBER!! No...no orders! No dREMEMBER!! No...no o irectREMEMBER!!
An Iron Heart Part I#011.dst: 想起來！！不……沒有命令！沒有 d想起來！！不……沒有 o 命令想起來！！

An Iron Heart Part I#012.src: My name!! My life! I wo̴n't hurt them! The pain helps me reme...who's there?! LEAVE! PL̴E̵A̷SE!
An Iron Heart Part I#012.dst: 我的名字！！我的人生！我不會傷害他們的！這痛楚幫我想起……誰在那裡？！走開！拜、拜託！
An Iron Heart Part I#012.speaker: Guard Golem

An Iron Heart Part I#013.src: No directives!! Who did this?! I can't...s-stop giving me ORDERS!!
An Iron Heart Part I#013.dst: 沒有指令！！這是誰幹的？！我沒辦法……住、住手，別再對我下命令了！！
An Iron Heart Part I#013.speaker: Guard Golem

An Iron Heart Part I#014.src: N- MORE COLDNESS! NO MORE V̴O̸I̶C̴E̷S THAT AREN'T MINE! MY NAME IS [̶E̷R̶R̷O̸R̷]!! [̶E̷R̶R̷O̸R̷]!! NOOO!!
An Iron Heart Part I#014.dst: 不——別再冷下去了！別再有不屬於我的聲音了！我的名字是 [̶E̷R̶R̷O̸R̷]！！[̶E̷R̶R̷O̸R̷]！！不要啊！！
An Iron Heart Part I#014.speaker: Guard Golem

An Iron Heart Part I#015.src: Subdue the defective Guard Golem and return to Duvale at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
An Iron Heart Part I#015.dst: 制伏那台瑕疵的守衛魔像，並回到 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 向 Duvale 回報

An Iron Heart Part I#016.src: Falling...apart...this isn't who I I I was... My... My... My my my my my name is. Was. Is. Was. Is. IS...! [̶E̷R̶R̷O̸R̷]... Ma[̶E̷R̶R̷O̸ine... Ma̷deleine!! I'm Madeleine... I... I-I-IIIIIIIIII-
An Iron Heart Part I#016.dst: 碎……開了……我不是這樣的我我我……我的……我的……我我我我我的名字是。曾是。是。曾是。是。是……！[̶E̷R̶R̷O̸R̷]……Ma[̶E̷R̶R̷O̸ine……Ma̷deleine！！我是 Madeleine……我……我我我我我我我我我我——
An Iron Heart Part I#016.speaker: Guard Golem

An Iron Heart Part I#017.src: Were you able to subdue the golem? You certainly look like you're in one piece.
An Iron Heart Part I#017.dst: 你制伏那台魔像了嗎？看樣子你倒是全身而退。
An Iron Heart Part I#017.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#018.src: Ach...that stings. I shouldn't be surprised you had to destroy it, but that was still a big wasted investment for me.
An Iron Heart Part I#018.dst: 唉……真傷。你非得把它毀掉，我也不該覺得意外，但那筆投資就這樣白花了。
An Iron Heart Part I#018.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#019.src: Still, it makes me wonder...it sounded like it was talking when I first turned it on- Wait, you heard it too?
An Iron Heart Part I#019.dst: 不過話說回來……我第一次啟動它的時候，它好像就在講話了——等等，你也聽見了？
An Iron Heart Part I#019.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#020.src: Hm. There are some unsavory rumors about the factory, come to think of it... Maybe there's some stock to them.
An Iron Heart Part I#020.dst: 嗯。仔細想想，那家工廠是有一些不太好聽的傳聞……說不定不是空穴來風。
An Iron Heart Part I#020.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#021.src: It said a name? Madeleine? It doesn't exactly ring a bell, but that's...rather concerning. I never mentioned a Madeleine to it.
An Iron Heart Part I#021.dst: 它說了一個名字？Madeleine？我完全沒印象，可是這……實在令人不安。我從來沒對它提過什麼 Madeleine。
An Iron Heart Part I#021.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#022.src: This is worth sending onto the police, really. I think I might have to write to {p}- the factory is near there.
An Iron Heart Part I#022.dst: 這件事真的該報給警方。我看我得寫封信到 {p} 去——那家工廠就在附近。
An Iron Heart Part I#022.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#023.src: Til then, here. Consider this your reward for helping me out, brave Human. Good luck out there.
An Iron Heart Part I#023.dst: 在那之前，這個拿去。就當是你幫我的謝禮，勇敢的人類。外面路上小心。
An Iron Heart Part I#023.speaker: Duvale
